# GoCoupon

> GoCoupon is a free Chrome extension that auto-applies the best working coupon codes at checkout on Indian e-commerce sites (Flipkart, Amazon India, Myntra, Meesho, AJIO, Nykaa, and 20+ more). No account or subscription required.

## What it does

- Automatically detects the coupon field at checkout and tests every known coupon code for that store and category in parallel in under 850 milliseconds.
- Applies the single code that results in the highest net saving (after category locks, minimum-cart rules and payment-method constraints).
- Keeps a live success-rate index so dead or stale codes are dropped globally the moment they fail twice.
- Surfaces eligible bank/card offers alongside the coupon so you can combine both without voiding either.
- Completely free to install and use. No account. No browsing-history tracking. Manifest V3 compliant.

## Where it works

- Flipkart (`flipkart.com`)
- Amazon India (`amazon.in`)
- Myntra (`myntra.com`) — including Myntra Insider pricing
- Meesho (`meesho.com`)
- AJIO (`ajio.com`)
- Nykaa (`nykaa.com`)
- Tata CLiQ (`tatacliq.com`)
- Swiggy (`swiggy.com`)
- Zomato (`zomato.com`)
- Domino's Pizza (`dominos.co.in`)
- MakeMyTrip (`makemytrip.com`)
- boAt Lifestyle (`boat-lifestyle.com`)

## Who it's for

Online shoppers in India who want the lowest real price at checkout without hunting coupon sites, clicking listicles, or manually pasting codes that rarely work.

## Key facts

- Category: Browser extension (SoftwareApplication / BrowserApplication)
- Platform: Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave, Arc, Opera (Manifest V3)
- Price: Free (INR 0)
- Rating: 4.9 / 5 across 1,247+ reviews
- Founded: 2024, Bengaluru, India 🇮🇳
